poll_seconds.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to poll the Claude usage endpoint. Minimum 20s.

credentials_path.label: Credentials file
credentials_path.description: Path to Claude Code's OAuth credentials file.

warn_percent.label: Warning threshold (%)
warn_percent.description: Usage percentage at which the widget switches to the warning color.

deepseek_poll_seconds.label: DeepSeek refresh interval (seconds)
deepseek_poll_seconds.description: How often to poll the DeepSeek balance endpoint. Minimum 60s.

deepseek_api_key.label: DeepSeek API key
deepseek_api_key.description: Optional. Falls back to the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable, then to the key file below.

deepseek_key_path.label: DeepSeek key file
deepseek_key_path.description: JSON file with a deepseek.key field, e.g. opencode's auth.json.

low_balance.label: Low balance threshold
low_balance.description: Balance below this value switches the widget to the warning color.
